What's new on Netflix?

Netflix is one of the most popular and exciting streaming services in the world. One of the main reasons why is that Netflix is always adding great new content to its library. With over 3000+ movies and 2400+ TV shows, there’s always something new to watch.

With this JustWatch guide, you can filter through the content on Netflix by choosing your favorite genre. Find a newly released sci-fi movie, or an action-comedy series like Cobra Kai that will have you entertained for hours. You can also sort by a film’s IMDb rating, or its age rating, to make sure that whatever you watch is suitable for the whole family.

New TV Shows On Netflix

Whether you’re watching classic shows from the 90s, or a brand-new series, you can always find something to stream on Netflix. The service is known for hit shows like Stranger Things, Wednesday and One Piece. You can discover all the new Netflix TV shows with this complete guide.

New Movies On Netflix

The platform is regularly releasing new movies to enjoy, across a range of genres. The streamer’s productions include big-name stars and world-class productions. Netflix has produced award-winning movies and worked with some of the most popular directors and actors in the world. This includes Martin Scorsese’s The Irishman starring Robert De Niro and Al Pacino, Alfonso Cuaron’s Roma, and Noah Baumbach’s Marriage Story starring Adam Driver and Scarlett Johansson. 

What’s Coming Soon To Netflix?

This list of upcoming releases allows you to see what new movies and series will be added to Netflix in the next few months. You can sort between the upcoming TV shows, and upcoming movies. Make a note in your calendar so you don’t miss the release day of your most anticipated Netflix content.
